mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 10% over three months signals weakening consumer demand and earnings pressure, which reduces corporate profit growth and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 10% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of two consecutive quarterly GDPC1 declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS over six months signals a monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS both rise over 6 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of simultaneous CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rises over six months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 98 for three consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of INDPRO < 98 for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 130,000 per month over six months signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 130,000 per month for six months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of PAYEMS > 130,000 per month for six months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 600,000 units for three consecutive months signals weakening residential investment, which reduces GDP growth and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 600,000 units for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of HOUST < 600,000 units for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above 13,000 for three consecutive quarters signals strengthening aggregate demand, which boosts corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of GDPC1 > 13,000 for three consecutive quarters (t-test p > 0.05).
